answer: A payout is split which means 34% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The orchard schedule is applied in walnut and tundra makes public each instalment. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3575 identities would post 2442 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
